summary: The agent provides a largely robust and well-structured DeepFM solution, strictly applying feature engineering and normalisation post-split to avoid data leakage. However, it suffers from an in-fold target encoding leakage because it computes target encodings directly on the train set without using out-of-fold techniques. Additionally, it trains the stochastic deep learning model only once and relies solely on a single evaluation metric.
